title: Maxwell's Equations
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly show that the magnetic field satisfies both divergence and curl equations of Maxwell's equations.

title: Field Lines Sketch
description: Important Criteria - The student should accurately sketch the magnetic field lines and indicate the placement of filamentary currents.

title: Magnetic Flux Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The student must calculate the magnetic flux per unit length correctly, providing the final expression.

title: Electric Potential Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The student must derive the correct expression for the electric potential measured by the observer moving with velocity v.

title: Electric Field from Varying B
description: Essential Criteria - The student must derive the correct expression for the electric field due to a slowly varying magnetic field.

title: Field Lines Equation
description: Important Criteria - The student should derive the correct differential equation for the field lines.

title: Flux Area Element
description: Optional Criteria - The student should correctly identify and describe the area element used in the magnetic flux calculation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations, especially in the electric potential and electric field derivations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
